mutants.description: The automatic oversampling threshold is already satisfied when the input face count equals the configured minimum.
An open mesh with Ask selected sets the public decision-required output before returning without colors.
A closed tetrahedron with one reversed face must pass through repair so the returned face normals have a consistent orientation.
When the public repair callback declines an open mesh, the existing pipeline keeps the original open mesh and continues importing it.
The low-poly adaptive vertex-color route respects max_cluster_k: one cluster keeps the triangle intact, while two separate colors split it into three faces.
